errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested by an ID that does not exist in the database.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is set to a value not in the allowed set (e.g., 'cancelled', 'completed', 'pending').

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when an order attempts to include a product that is out of stock.

errors.name: AtomicOperationFailedError
errors.description: Raised when an atomic operation (such as creating an order or cancelling an order) fails due to a database constraint or transaction rollback, indicating the system cannot proceed with the current state.
